speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To understand your condition better, can you tell me if you've noticed any changes in your urine, such as color, frequency, or pain during urination?

Please also describe how your fever has been behaving—has it been constant, spiking, or responding to medication?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of persistent fever, flank pain, and fatigue following a recent systemic infection (sinusitis) strongly suggests a kidney infection, likely caused by hematogenous spread or ascending infection, even if urinary symptoms are not yet prominent. Please have your medical team obtain a Urinalysis and Blood Cultures immediately to confirm the diagnosis and guide antibiotic selection.
